methodology.implementation_order: rotates json/dcbor/cbor2_default/cbor2_canonical/cborx_default/cborx_canonical/orjson_default/orjson_sorted/msgspec_msgpack/msgspec_msgpack_deterministic/cbrrr_strictdagcbor start order across fresh processes
methodology.summary: median of per-process batch means; dispersion is median absolute deviation (MAD)
methodology.decode_input: precomputed encoded bytes for that implementation and fixture
methodology.round_trip: one encode followed by one decode within each timed call

cbor_comparators.dcbor: dcbor source extension version 0.1.0, required release artifact
cbor_comparators.cbor2_default: generic CBOR library cbor2==6.1.5, dumps() default canonical=False
cbor_comparators.cbor2_canonical: generic CBOR library cbor2==6.1.5, dumps(canonical=True), length-first key order (legacy RFC 8949 section 4.2.3)
cbor_comparators.cborx_default: generic CBOR library cborx==0.2.5, dumps() default canonical=False; backend recorded
cbor_comparators.cborx_canonical: generic CBOR library cborx==0.2.5, dumps(canonical=True), bytewise encoded-key order per project documentation

other_codecs.orjson_default: JSON library orjson==3.13.0, dumps() defaults; native extension recorded
other_codecs.orjson_sorted: orjson==3.13.0, dumps(option=orjson.OPT_SORT_KEYS); sorted JSON object keys
other_codecs.msgspec_msgpack: msgspec==0.22.0, preconstructed msgspec.msgpack.Encoder()/Decoder() objects; insertion-order maps
other_codecs.msgspec_msgpack_deterministic: msgspec==0.22.0, preconstructed Encoder(order='deterministic') and Decoder(); deterministic unordered-container order
other_codecs.cbrrr_strictdagcbor: cbrrr==1.1.0, encode_dag_cbor()/decode_dag_cbor() wrappers for its documented strict DAG-CBOR API, measured as shipped; native extension recorded

methodology.map_key_order: dcbor, cbrrr strict DAG-CBOR, and cborx canonical=True use bytewise ordering; cbor2 canonical=True uses length-first ordering (legacy RFC 8949 section 4.2.3); orjson sorted uses sorted JSON string keys; msgspec deterministic sorts unordered maps
methodology.cbor_scope: cbor2 and cborx are generic CBOR comparators, not dCBOR implementations; cbrrr uses its strict DAG-CBOR API; defaults and named modes are reported separately
methodology.api_lifecycle: msgspec uses preconstructed Encoder/Decoder objects per worker; json, dcbor, cbor2, cborx, orjson, and cbrrr use their documented function wrappers directly
methodology.profile_differences: MessagePack and DAG-CBOR are distinct wire formats; generic cbor2/cborx modes are not dCBOR conformance claims; JSON libraries retain their own formatting and numeric behavior
methodology.cbrrr_scope: This measures cbrrr's documented strict DAG-CBOR API as shipped, not an independent conformance certification; cbrrr==1.1.0 accepts and emits negative zero (absent from these common fixtures) and rejects NaN/Infinity. Profile guarantees differ.
methodology.excluded: a separate validation-only operation is excluded; each decoder keeps its own semantics, including cbrrr's documented strict DAG-CBOR API
